title: Shakshuka
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and pepper and soften them in the oil in a pan for 5 minutes.
Briefly toast the cumin and paprika, add the tomatoes and simmer uncovered for 8–10 minutes to a thick sauce, then season with salt.
Make four hollows with a spoon, crack an egg into each and cook covered over low heat for 5–7 minutes until set.
Sprinkle with feta and parsley and serve with bread.
